Loss report: gitlab -> tekton
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.api (the source runs on the events api, trigger and its file has no trigger form for them; Tekton has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.pipeline_done (the source runs on the events pipeline, parent_pipeline and its file has no trigger form for them; Tekton has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.resource (the source runs on the events external, chat and its file has no trigger form for them; Tekton has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.schedule (the source runs on the events schedule and its file has no trigger form for them; Tekton has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.manual: tkn pipeline start gitlab-ci (a person starts the run with `tkn pipeline start gitlab-ci`)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.pull_request: same-repository pull requests only; Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (the filter admits only pull requests from this repository, because the code of a fork would run with every secret of the Task; GitHub Actions withholds secrets from fork runs. Remove the head.repo term of the filter to accept forks; create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/2 trigger.push: Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/3 trigger.tag: Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.if: shell guard (the condition has no when form; the script steps start with a guard line that reads the values from step env)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present preamble in the script (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the script starts with a line that re-runs it under bash -e when the image has bash, else it runs under sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/source-checkout step.action: StepAction ref to the tektoncd-catalog git-clone through the git resolver (the ctx-repo and ctx-sha params carry the repository and the commit)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/mrjob/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present preamble in the script (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the script starts with a line that re-runs it under bash -e when the image has bash, else it runs under sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/mrjob/step/source-checkout step.action: StepAction ref to the tektoncd-catalog git-clone through the git resolver (the ctx-repo and ctx-sha params carry the repository and the commit)
